name: Cornflakes
siboNotes: Plain cornflakes are well-tolerated for SIBO as they're made from corn which is naturally low in fermentable carbohydrates.
preparationTips: Choose plain varieties without added high-FODMAP ingredients like honey or inulin
Pair with lactose-free milk or small amounts of regular milk (up to 1/2 cup)
Check labels for added fibers like chicory root or inulin which are high FODMAP
Store in airtight container to maintain crispness
nutritionalHighlights: Often fortified with iron and B vitamins
Low in fiber and easy to digest
Quick source of carbohydrates for energy
Typically low in fat and protein
